blocks.text: Architecting a Hybrid Security & Management Fabric for a Global IT Services Provider
IT-Enabled Services
Client
An IT services and solution provider with marquee clients across the globe and a culture focused on innovation.
Ambition
To build on their existing cloud investment to create a comprehensive, hybrid security and device management framework for their global workforce.
Outcome
Architected and deployed a hybrid solution that integrated cloud and on-premise tools to deliver advanced security, comprehensive device management, and self-service IT capabilities.
The Ambition
An IT services and solution provider with marquee clients across the globe and a culture focused on innovation.
The Challenge

While they had adopted a SaaS cloud platform, they needed to add more advanced security layers. Key challenges included managing endpoints, preventing data leakage, and reducing the heavy load on their helpdesk for common tasks like password resets.
The Architectural Blueprint

The client's ambition was to deliver a superior, people-centric customer experience, which required empowering their own employees with the right tools in a secure manner. They needed to extend their existing cloud platform with more advanced security layers to protect data and manage a diverse landscape of devices.
Ambition, Realized

The hybrid solution allowed them to realize tangible business value from both their on-premise and cloud investments. Data leakage fears were completely put to rest with secure encryption and detailed document tracking. Greatly reduced helpdesk workloads freed IT to focus on more strategic initiatives. Single Sign-On (SSO) eased user pain points and improved productivity, all without compromising on security or compliance requirements.
Key Business Impact
Integrated On-Premise & Cloud for a Unified Security Fabric
Reduced Helpdesk Workload with Self-Service IT
Strengthened Data Protection with Persistent Encryption
Improved User Productivity with Single Sign-On (SSO)
